name: digit_copy
description: Exact copying of an isolated decimal digit from a simple record; control copies a capital letter in the same record.
generator_code:
import random,json,string
random.seed(0)
a=[];b=[]
for i in range(120):
 d=str(random.randrange(10)); c=random.choice(string.ascii_uppercase); text=f'Record: digit={d}; letter={c}.\n'
 a.append({'prompt':text+'Copy the digit:','answer':' '+d})
 b.append({'prompt':text+'Copy the letter:','answer':' '+c})
json.dump({'items':a,'control':b},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
